title: Navigation commands
description: Walking an NPC to the player and turning it to face him

console: animus create greeter name=greeter world=world x=-2.5 y=64 z=-9.5
animus create trader type=minecraft:llama name=trader world=world x=4.5 y=64 z=-9.5

beats.result: chat reads fountain-keeper heading to -7.5 64 9.5 (walk); the Keeper sets off
the status line: moving to -7.5 64 9.5, and where the Keeper is now
the Keeper arrives and stands three blocks in front of you
the status line now reads arrived at -7.5 64 9.5
chat reads fountain-keeper looks at -0.5 64 9.5; the Keeper turns to you

closing: The Keeper walked to the player and turned to face him
